documents.title: Example UCB Retail Loan Policy v3

facts.sentence: Foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower.
facts.subject: pre-payment / foreclosure charges
facts.value: 2% + GST of principal outstanding, on all term loans

rbi_reference.title: RBI (Urban Co-operative Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
RBI (Urban Co-operative Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
RBI (Urban Co-operative Banks - Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025
RBI (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025

facts.note: Blanket charge on 'all term loans'. Not allowed on floating-rate non-business loans to individuals (para 260 for loans sanctioned before 31 Dec 2025; para 261(1) for loans sanctioned/renewed on or after 1 Jan 2026) nor, for a Tier 3 UCB, on floating-rate business loans to individuals/MSEs up to ₹50 lakh (para 261(2)(ii)). The policy (effective 1 Apr 2023) predates the 2025 Directions.

facts.sentence: Penal interest at 2% per month over the applicable rate of interest shall be charged on overdue instalments and compounded monthly.
facts.subject: penal interest

Penal Charges in Loan Accounts - extension of timeline

facts.note: Two breaches: penalty levied as 'penal interest' added to the rate, and compounding (capitalisation) of the penalty. Rule applies to fresh loans from 1 Apr 2024 and existing loans from the next review/renewal, not later than 30 Jun 2024.

facts.sentence: Processing fee and documentation charges shall be recovered as applicable at the time of sanction.
